title: Buffer tape as a processed zipper
statement: For every Boolean word $b_s$, its buffer tape equals the zipper tape with frontier at $|b_s|$, processed stack consisting of the bits of $b_s$ in reverse order, and empty unprocessed list.
replaced:
The buffer tape of a word also equals the zipper with frontier at the word's
length, the reversed word as the processed stack, and an empty unprocessed
list.
